cohort: A 25-year-old woman who developed a uterocutaneous fistula 13 months after her first Cesarean section.
finding: Successful surgical management involving debridement of necrotic tissue, excision of fistula tracts, and drainage of the uterine cavity led to no recurrence of a uterocutaneous fistula at 8 months' follow-up.
mod_finding: The uterocutaneous fistula occurred following a Cesarean section, highlighting a rare complication associated with this mode of birth.
